items.title: PRESIDENT’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Openings and Events b) Commission Administrative Matters c) Acknowledgements

GENERAL MANAGER’S REPORT (DISCUSSION ONLY) a) Financial Matters b) Capital Report c) Property Management d) Recreation Programs e) Park, Recreation and Open Space Advisory Committee Report f) Events g) Legislation

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT - UP TO 15 MINUTES – THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO ITEM 14 At this time, members of the public may address the Commission on items of interest to the public that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission and that do not appear on the agenda. With respect to agenda items, you will have opportunity to address the Commission when the item is reached in the meeting.
SAN FRANCISCO ZOO Presentation and discussion only to update the Commission on operational and management issues at the San Francisco Zoo. (DISCUSSION ONLY)

TENDERLOIN RECREATION CENTER IMPROVEMENTS – CONTRACT AWARD Discussion and possible action to award a construction contract for the Tenderloin Rec Center Children’s Play Area Improvement Project (Contract No. 0000010562) to Bauman Landscape & Construction, Inc. in the amount of up to $1,638,460 to cover (1) the base bid ($1,528,000), (2) bid alternate #1 ($22,460), and (3) change order for bid alternates #3 & #4 ($88,000). (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Keri Ayers –

LYFT BIKESHARE – FIVE-YEAR REVOCABLE PERMIT Discussion and possible action to approve a five-year Permit to Lyft to operate bikeshare within San Francisco parks. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Christian Gayagoy –

MISSION CREEK PARK PAVILION – LEASE AGREEMENT AND LEASE EXTENSION Discussion and possible action to authorize the Department to enter into a lease agreement for a period of up to three years with two three year extension options with Bourbon Coffee, Inc. dba Zocalo Coffee, for the purpose of offering food and beverage service at the Mission Creek Park Pavilion in Mission Bay with terms substantially the same as the term sheet dated June 30, 2025. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Neal Patel – 10. UNION SQUARE – IN-KIND GRANT AND PERMIT FOR SOUND SYSTEM INSTALLATION Discussion and possible action to recommend that (1) the Board of Supervisors authorize the Recreation and Parks Department to accept an in-kind grant from the Union Square Alliance (USA) valued at approximately $300,000 for the installation of pillars that would enable sound systems to be installed and (2) authorize the Department to enter into a permit, for a term of no more than nine years, for USA to install and use speakers and other related equipment on the pillars. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Susan Sun – and Hank Heckel –

PALACE OF FINE ARTS – WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT LEASE Discussion and possible action to authorize the Department to enter into a lease with New Cingular Wireless PCS for a term of nine years and six months to install, operate and maintain an antenna structure and related wireless telecommunications equipment at the Palace of Fine Arts with terms substantially the same as the draft lease dated June 2025. The General Manager shall be authorized to approve changes from the draft lease that do not increase the lease term, decrease the rent, or increase the City’s liabilities or obligations under the Lease. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: Hank Heckel –

ACTIVENET SOFTWARE SERVICE AGREEMENT – EXTENSION Discussion and possible action to recommend that the Board of Supervisors approve an amendment of the software service agreement between the Recreation and Park Department and ActiveNet Recreation and Permits Business Services, to authorize a 2-year extension of the agreement from January 2026 through December 2027. (ACTION ITEM) Staff: AnneMarie Donnelly –
CLOSED SESSION – CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL REGARDING SETTLEMENT

GENERAL PUBLIC COMMENT – CONTINUED FROM ITEM 4 IF NECESSARY At this time members of the public who were not able to address the Commission on Item 4 may address the Commission on items that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Recreation and Park Commission that do not appear on the agenda. (ACTION ITEM)

COMMISSIONERS’ MATTERS This item is designed to allow Commissioners to raise issues they believe the Commission should address at future meetings. There will be no discussion of these items at this time.
